%doc: Source-of-truth manifest of the structured data Module:Entity stores in Bucket. Keys are display names, which Module:Entity/StructuredData derives from the emitter key (ucfirst, underscores to spaces). type: Bucket field type; bucket: Bucket table, or an object keyed by kind name when the same property lives in a different table per kind; field: the Bucket column (lowercase snake_case of the emitter key); index/repeated: Bucket flags, absent = false; modules: emitting Entity modules. Data is stored UNITLESS. pages/bucket/<Name>.json schemas are generated from this file by `mise run bucket:schemas`. Limits verified live: 60 fields per bucket, bucket+field name at most 51 characters, repeated implies index.

Acquisition kind.desc: Acquisition kind of a commodity record.

Added in version.desc: Game update in which an entity first became available in-game (the canonical Update: patch page). For vehicles this is the flight-ready patch, rendered as the Development "Flight ready in" row.

Affiliation.desc: Controlling empire / affiliation of a star system, in the compact vocabulary the pre-Entity pages already store ('UEE', 'Unclaimed', ...) so queries keep one value bucket.

Ammo.desc: Magazine / ammunition capacity of a weapon.

Arm time.desc: Arming delay of a bomb, in seconds.

Available.desc: Whether a mission is currently available.

Average purchase price.desc: Estimated in-game purchase price of a vehicle (median of the latest patch's UEX terminal prices), in aUEC.

Average rental price.desc: Estimated in-game rental price of a vehicle (median of the latest patch's UEX terminal prices), in aUEC.

Base variant.desc: Whether an item is the canonical base piece (true) rather than a colorway or edition variant (false).

Beam force.desc: Pull/push force of a tractor or towing beam, in newtons.

Beam max angle.desc: Maximum articulation angle of a tractor/towing beam, in degrees.

Beam mode force.desc: Heavy-lift mode force of a beam (cargo/tow), in newtons.

Beam range.desc: Maximum range of a tractor/towing beam, in metres.

Beam tether break.desc: Tether break time of a towing beam, in seconds.

Beds.desc: Number of beds aboard a vehicle.

Biochemical damage modifier.desc: Biochemical damage taken multiplier for vehicle armor (1.0 = no change).

Biochemical resistance.desc: Biochemical damage resistance of armor, as a percentage.

Blast radius.desc: Area-of-effect blast radius of a grenade, in metres.

Blood drug level.desc: Blood drug level a medical consumable raises when administered.

Boost speed.desc: Boosted forward flight speed set by a flight controller, in m/s.

Capacity count.desc: Number of ordnance a rack carries.

Capacity size.desc: Size of each ordnance a rack carries.

Career.desc: Career category of a vehicle (Combat, Transport, Exploration, …).

Cargo capacity.desc: Cargo capacity of a vehicle, in SCU.

Charges.desc: Number of charges of a mining module, or breach charges of a cryptokey.

Class.desc: Component class (Military, Civilian, Industrial, …) of a graded vehicle component.

Class name.desc: Game-data class name of an entity (AEGS_Gladius), the stable identifier for matching a page against the game files or another site's dataset. Absent on missions, which carry no class name.

Classification.desc: Spectral class of a star, as the star infobox's subtitle words it ('K-type main-sequence star', 'White dwarf', 'Stellar black hole'; hyphenated to match the wiki's article titles). Editorial text wins over the starmap sub_type, so lore-only classes ('K-type main-sequence flare star') store faithfully, delinked. Duplicates the kind-generic Subject type for classed stars; it earns its place by letting a location query filter on class without joining the entity bucket.

Coolant generation.desc: Coolant generated per segment by a cooler.

Crew stations.desc: Number of crew operating stations aboard a vehicle.

Cross section signature modifier.desc: Cross-section signature multiplier for vehicle armor (1.0 = no change).

Damage.desc: Damage value of a weapon or grenade.

Damage class.desc: Damage class of a personal weapon (Ballistic, Energy, …).

Damage repair rate.desc: Maximum damage-map repair rate of a salvage head.

Density.desc: Density of a commodity, in g/cm³.

Destination system.desc: Star system on the far side of a jump-point tunnel, stored as the wiki page name ('Nyx system'): the side of the starmap celestial designation that is not the gate's entry system.

Discovered by.desc: Discoverer of a star system (editorial; the APIs do not model discovery).

Discovered in.desc: Lore year a star system was discovered (editorial; the APIs do not model discovery).

Distortion.desc: Maximum distortion health of a component.

Distortion damage modifier.desc: Distortion damage taken multiplier for vehicle armor (1.0 = no change).

Distortion resistance.desc: Distortion damage resistance of armor, as a percentage.

Dps.desc: Damage per second of a weapon.

Drop angle.desc: Maximum drop angle of a bomb, in degrees.

Duration.desc: Effect duration of a mining module, in seconds.

Electromagnetic signature modifier.desc: Electromagnetic signature multiplier for vehicle armor (1.0 = no change).

Emp charge time.desc: Charge duration of an EMP generator, in seconds.

Emp cooldown.desc: Cooldown of an EMP generator, in seconds.

Emp distortion damage.desc: Distortion damage of an EMP generator.

Emp duration.desc: Unleash duration of an EMP generator, in seconds.

Emp radius.desc: Radius of an EMP generator, in metres.

Energy damage modifier.desc: Energy damage taken multiplier for vehicle armor (1.0 = no change).

Energy resistance.desc: Energy damage resistance of armor, as a percentage.

Error chance.desc: Per-attempt failure chance of a cryptokey, as a percentage.

Explosion radius.desc: Explosion radius of a bomb or missile, in metres.

Extraction efficiency.desc: Salvage extraction efficiency of a salvage head, as a fraction.

Extraction throughput.desc: Extraction throughput of a mining laser head.

Fire rate.desc: Fire rate of a weapon, in rounds per minute.

Firing type.desc: Firing mechanism of a vehicle weapon (Cannon, Repeater, …).

Full damage range.desc: Distance (m) over which a personal weapon deals full damage before falloff begins.

G force resistance.desc: G-force resistance modifier a suit confers to the wearer.

Generation.desc: Vehicle generation within its series (e.g. II, III).

Grade.desc: Component grade (A–D) of a graded vehicle component.

Health point.desc: Hull hit points of a vehicle.

Health repair rate.desc: Maximum health repair rate of a salvage head.

Hei.desc: Hydration Efficacy Index of a consumable.

Hydrogen fuel capacity.desc: Hydrogen fuel tank capacity of a vehicle.

Hydrogen fuel intake rate.desc: Hydrogen fuel intake rate of a vehicle.

Impact resistance.desc: Impact damage resistance of armor, as a percentage.

Insurance claim time.desc: Standard insurance claim time of a vehicle, in minutes.

Insurance expedite cost.desc: Insurance expedite fee of a vehicle, in aUEC.

Insurance expedite time.desc: Insurance expedite time of a vehicle, in minutes.

Infrared signature modifier.desc: Infrared signature multiplier for vehicle armor (1.0 = no change).

Jump alignment rate.desc: Quantum alignment rate of a jump module.

Jump fuel usage multiplier.desc: Quantum fuel-usage multiplier of a jump module.

Jump point count.desc: Number of jump points in a star system (typed celestialObjects count from the starmap record).

Jump point size.desc: Ship size class a jump point admits (Small, Medium, Large), mapped from the starmap jumppoints.size code (S/M/L); an unmapped code stores nothing.

Jump tuning rate.desc: Quantum tuning rate of a jump module.

Laser range.desc: Effective range of a laser pointer attachment, in metres.

Legality.desc: Verified or unverified legality of a mission, as the API reports it.

Loaner vehicle.desc: Loaner vehicles granted while an unreleased vehicle is in production (suppressed for flight-ready vehicles).

Lock angle.desc: Lock-on cone angle of a missile, in degrees.

Lock range.desc: Maximum lock-on range of a missile, in metres.

Lock time.desc: Lock-on time of a missile, in seconds.

Magnification.desc: Optical magnification of a scope or rangefinder (e.g. 8 means 8×).

Manual API field.desc: Editorial field keys that were hand-supplied for API-owned data (fill or override); drives the 'Entities with manual API data' maintenance category.

Mass.desc: Mass of a vehicle, in kg.

Material efficiency.desc: Material efficiency of a salvage head, as a fraction.

Max range.desc: Maximum range of a weapon, in metres (personal weapons / gadgets display it as "Range").

Max speed.desc: Maximum flight/travel speed in m/s (a vehicle's, or set by a flight controller).

Maximum cargo container size.desc: Largest single cargo container the vehicle's cargo grid accepts, in SCU.

Maximum crew.desc: Maximum crew count of a vehicle.

Maximum range.desc: Maximum mining range of a mining laser head, in metres.

Maximum temperature.desc: Hottest temperature a wearable protects against, in °C.

Medical bed tier.desc: Highest medical bed tier aboard a vehicle (1-3).

Min damage.desc: Floored per-shot damage a personal weapon deals at long range after falloff.

Minimum crew.desc: Minimum crew count of a vehicle.

Minimum temperature.desc: Coldest temperature a wearable protects against, in °C.

Mining type.desc: Mining modifier type of a mining module.

Missile range.desc: Flight range of a missile, in metres.

Missile speed.desc: Speed of a missile, in m/s.

Modifier cluster factor.desc: Cluster factor change a mining module or laser head applies, as a signed percentage.

Modifier extraction laser power.desc: Extraction laser power change a mining module or laser head applies, as a signed percentage.

Modifier inert materials.desc: Inert material level change a mining module or laser head applies, as a signed percentage; negated from the API's all_charge_rates so a reduction reads negative.

Modifier laser instability.desc: Laser instability change a mining module or laser head applies, as a signed percentage.

Modifier mining laser power.desc: Mining (fracture) laser power change a mining module or laser head applies, as a signed percentage.

Modifier optimal charge rate.desc: Optimal charge rate change a mining module or laser head applies, as a signed percentage.

Modifier optimal charge window size.desc: Optimal charge window size change a mining module or laser head applies, as a signed percentage.

Modifier overcharge rate.desc: Overcharge rate change a mining module or laser head applies, as a signed percentage.

Modifier resistance.desc: Resistance change a mining module or laser head applies, as a signed percentage.

Modifier shatter damage.desc: Shatter damage change a mining module or laser head applies, as a signed percentage.

Module slots.desc: Number of mining-module slots on a mining laser head.

Moon count.desc: Number of moons (SATELLITE objects) in a star system.

Muzzle velocity.desc: Muzzle velocity of a weapon, in m/s.

Ndr.desc: Nutritional Density Rating of a consumable.

Optimal range.desc: Optimal mining range of a mining laser head, in metres.

Ore capacity.desc: Mining ore hold capacity of a vehicle, in SCU.

Original pledge price.desc: Original (launch) standalone pledge price of a vehicle, in USD.

Original warbond pledge price.desc: Original (launch) warbond pledge price of a vehicle, in USD.

Physical damage modifier.desc: Physical damage taken multiplier for vehicle armor (1.0 = no change).

Physical resistance.desc: Physical damage resistance of armor, as a percentage.

Pilot DPS.desc: Total damage per second of a vehicle's pilot-controlled weapons (stock loadout).

Star radius.desc: Radius of a star in kilometres, from the starmap size or an editorial |radius=. Absent where the starmap carries a placeholder instead of a measurement (see the Star leaf's radiusKm); the in-game record's size is never stored, being a placeholder for two of the three stars that have one.

Turret DPS.desc: Total damage per second of a vehicle's crew/turret weapons (stock loadout).

Pilot sustained DPS.desc: Sustained (capacitor/heat-limited) damage per second of a vehicle's pilot-controlled weapons (stock loadout).

Turret sustained DPS.desc: Sustained (capacitor/heat-limited) damage per second of a vehicle's crew/turret weapons (stock loadout).

Missile damage.desc: Total damage of a vehicle's missile loadout.

Armor resistance.desc: Mean damage resistance across damage types, as a percent (0-100).

Armor deflection.desc: Mean armor deflection threshold (physical and energy): the minimum per-shot damage needed to penetrate; higher is tougher.

Physical deflection.desc: Physical armor deflection threshold: the minimum per-shot physical damage needed to penetrate; higher is tougher.

Energy deflection.desc: Energy armor deflection threshold: the minimum per-shot energy damage needed to penetrate; higher is tougher.

Infrared emission.desc: Infrared signature emission of a vehicle (lower is stealthier).

Electromagnetic emission.desc: Maximum electromagnetic signature emission of a vehicle (lower is stealthier).

Cross section.desc: Mean radar cross-section signature of a vehicle across its three axes (lower is stealthier).

Cross section length.desc: Radar cross-section signature of a vehicle along its length axis (lower is stealthier).

Cross section width.desc: Radar cross-section signature of a vehicle along its width axis (lower is stealthier).

Cross section height.desc: Radar cross-section signature of a vehicle along its height axis (lower is stealthier).

Pitch.desc: Pitch traverse range of a seat or flight controller (display string).

Pitch boosted.desc: Boosted pitch rate of a flight controller, in °/s.

Pitch max.desc: Maximum pitch angle of a seat, in degrees.

Pitch min.desc: Minimum pitch angle of a seat, in degrees.

Pitch rate.desc: Pitch agility rate of a vehicle, in °/s.

Pitch speed.desc: Pitch rotation speed of a turret, in °/s.

Planet count.desc: Number of planets in a star system. The Star leaf stores a star's own satellites here rather than adding a column for the same fact; note that every live binary carries the SYSTEM total on both stars (Tyrol A and B both 7), so a star row's value is not a per-star figure and an aggregate query must filter by Subject type.

Pledge availability.desc: Pledge store availability status of a vehicle (e.g. Available, Limited, Unavailable).

Pledge price.desc: MSRP pledge price of a vehicle, in USD.

Power generation.desc: Power generated per segment by a power plant.

Power output.desc: Power output of a power plant.

Production state.desc: Production/flight-readiness state of a vehicle (e.g. Flight Ready, In Production).

Qig charge time.desc: Charge time of a quantum interdiction generator, in seconds.

Qig cooldown.desc: Cooldown of a quantum interdiction generator, in seconds.

Qig dampener range.desc: Quantum dampener range of a quantum interdiction generator, in metres.

Qig duration.desc: Discharge duration of a quantum interdiction generator, in seconds.

Qig mode.desc: Mode of a quantum interdiction generator (QED, QDMP, QID).

Qig snare range.desc: Quantum snare radius of a quantum interdiction generator, in metres.

Quantum cooldown.desc: Cooldown of a quantum drive, in seconds.

Quantum fuel requirement.desc: Quantum fuel requirement of a quantum drive.

Quantum fuel capacity.desc: Quantum fuel tank capacity of a vehicle.

Quantum range.desc: Quantum travel range of a vehicle, in Gm.

Quantum speed.desc: Travel speed of a quantum drive or vehicle in quantum travel, in Mm/s.

Quantum spool time.desc: Spool-up time of a quantum drive, in seconds.

Radar aim assist range.desc: Aim-assist assignment range of a radar, in metres.

Radiation capacity.desc: Maximum radiation a suit can absorb before its protection fails.

Radiation dissipation.desc: Rate at which a suit dissipates absorbed radiation.

Radius multiplier.desc: Salvage radius multiplier of a scraper module.

Ramp down time.desc: Salvage ramp-down time of a salvage head, in seconds.

Ramp up time.desc: Salvage ramp-up time of a salvage head, in seconds.

Range increment.desc: Per-step range increment of an iron-sight attachment, in metres.

Rarity.desc: Rarity tier of an item (Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary).

Reputation max.desc: Maximum reputation standing at which a mission is offered.

Reputation min.desc: Minimum reputation standing required for a mission.

Retracted height.desc: Retracted (folded) height of a vehicle, in metres.

Retracted length.desc: Retracted (folded) length of a vehicle, in metres.

Retracted width.desc: Retracted (folded) width of a vehicle, in metres.

Roll.desc: Base roll rate of a flight controller, in °/s.

Roll boosted.desc: Boosted roll rate of a flight controller, in °/s.

Roll rate.desc: Roll agility rate of a vehicle, in °/s.

Role.desc: Role of a vehicle (e.g. Light Fighter, Heavy Bomber, Cargo).

Salvage speed multiplier.desc: Salvage speed multiplier of a scraper module.

Scm speed.desc: SCM (combat) speed in m/s (a vehicle's, or set by a flight controller).

Series.desc: Vehicle series/product line a vehicle belongs to.

Shield health.desc: Maximum shield health of a shield generator.

Shield regen delay.desc: Shield regeneration delay after damage, in seconds.

Shield regeneration.desc: Shield regeneration rate of a shield generator.

Shield health point.desc: Shield hit points of a vehicle.

Ship matrix size.desc: Curated ship-matrix size name of a vehicle (Small, Medium, Large, ...); the numeric size class is stored as Size.

Size.desc: Numeric size of an entity: a component's slot size, or a vehicle's size class (1–10).

Slash damage.desc: Blade-slash damage of a melee weapon.

Stab damage.desc: Blade-stab damage of a melee weapon.

Star count.desc: Number of stars in a star system.

Station count.desc: Number of stations (MANMADE objects) in a star system.

Storage capacity.desc: Inventory carrying capacity of a garment, container, or vehicle (personal stowage), in µSCU.

Stun damage modifier.desc: Stun damage taken multiplier for vehicle armor (1.0 = no change).

Stun resistance.desc: Stun damage resistance of armor, as a percentage.

Subject type.desc: Most-specific structural type of the page subject (e.g. Gun, Cooler, Company). Injected centrally by Module:Entity from the resolved typeInfo.

System.desc: Star system a location resides in, stored as the wiki page name ('Pyro system'). Written by the JumpPoint leaf (the gate's entry system) and the Star leaf; the vocabulary is kind-wide for future Location leaves.

System size.desc: Aggregated size of a star system in AU (stored unitless; editorial-overridable via |size=). Retyped Number on-wiki 2026-08-17 (was a pre-manifest Quantity page with 'Corresponds to 1 AU'); consumers append the AU unit at display time.

System type.desc: Star-topology type of a system as the SYSTEM_TYPES display label ('Single star system', 'Binary star system'), the same string the infobox subtitle shows. Retyped from raw starmap codes 2026-08-17 when legacy Module:System retired and this became the only writer; an unmapped ARK code still stores raw as the fallback.

Systems.desc: Star systems a commodity or mission is associated with (multi-valued).

Thermal damage modifier.desc: Thermal damage taken multiplier for vehicle armor (1.0 = no change).

Thermal resistance.desc: Thermal damage resistance of armor, as a percentage.

Volume.desc: Volume of an item, in microSCU.

Warbond pledge price.desc: Warbond pledge price of a vehicle, in USD.

Warhead damage.desc: Total warhead damage of a bomb or missile.

Weapon class.desc: Player-facing weapon class of a personal weapon (Pistol, Assault Rifle, …).

Weapon rack capacity.desc: Total personal weapon rack slots aboard a vehicle.

Weight class.desc: Weight class of an armor piece (Light, Medium, Heavy, Super heavy).

Yaw.desc: Yaw traverse range of a seat or flight controller (display string).

Yaw boosted.desc: Boosted yaw rate of a flight controller, in °/s.

Yaw max.desc: Maximum yaw angle of a seat, in degrees.

Yaw min.desc: Minimum yaw angle of a seat, in degrees.

Yaw rate.desc: Yaw agility rate of a vehicle, in °/s.

Yaw speed.desc: Yaw rotation speed of a turret, in °/s.

Zero to Maximum speed time.desc: Time in seconds to accelerate from a standstill to maximum speed.

Image.desc: Infobox image filename without the File: prefix, the value PageImages picks as the page image.
